facts.business: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited is engaged in the supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of Kavach (Train Collision Avoidance System) and other railway signaling and safety systems for Indian Railways and its production units.

auditor.name: NSVR & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on recoverability of trade receivables (₹422.73 lakhs, ECL provision ₹309.59 lakhs), margin money deposits (₹265.03 lakhs), advances to Kernex TCAS JV (₹637.87 lakhs, ECL allowance ₹403.07 lakhs), and impairment loss on investment in Avant-Garde Infosystems Inc.

key_risks: Recoverability of trade receivables from a customer (₹422.73 lakhs) with ECL provision of ₹309.59 lakhs
Recoverability of margin money deposits with banks (₹265.03 lakhs) against bank guarantees where arbitration/conciliation proceedings are pending
Recoverability of advances including interest accrued (₹637.87 lakhs) to Kernex TCAS JV with ECL allowance of ₹403.07 lakhs
Impairment loss recognised on investment in wholly owned subsidiary Avant-Garde Infosystems Inc., USA
facts.related_party_note: Personal guarantees provided by promoter Sitarama Raju Manthena for various bank borrowings; shares pledged by promoter in personal capacity not connected to company borrowings.
